calls.reason: The claim is hedged ("seriously doubt"). The packet holds only a 2025 RAG study scored by automated judges and a brief 2023 obituary test, so nothing checks both facts and engagement across both genres.
"Almost certain" is a confidence phrase, and the claim depends on Marcus reading Musk correctly. The Ars Technica and NBIM sources do not show Musk meant every intellectual task.
"Anytime soon" has no endpoint. The evidence is mixed: Kosmos reports expert-corroborated findings and AI Scientist papers passed workshop review, but independent checks found serious flaws.

The claim is hedged ("seriously doubt"). VideoGameBench, SIMA 2 and NitroGen show partial transfer to unseen games and clear limits, but none times rapid learning plus puzzle-solving across almost any game.
"Seem" hedges the claim, and the evidence is piecemeal. DARPA RACER off-road runs and Mobile ALOHA cover parts of tasks, while many listed tasks have no evidence either way.
